description: Grade, camera, shape, speaker cut-out, a replay, or style_id to switch the whole video to a style. Cost: Free.

arrive.description: Seconds the move takes to arrive; 0.23 by default.

ease.description: How it arrives: bounce (the default: a small overshoot and one settle), smooth, linear, ease-in or ease-out, with no overshoot.

pivot.description: [x, y] it zooms toward, fractions of the frame.

scale.description: How far in; 1.1 is a small punch-in.

cut_out_speaker.description: Cut the speaker out; saved alone, a job of minutes (check_video).

saturation.description: 0 black and white, 1 as is, 2 vivid.

replay.description: Plays once, then again at this speed (5 is 5x); null removes it. Saved alone.

add.description: true keeps this shape and adds the new one as another output.

fit.description: subject follows the speaker (the main shape only: with add: true use cover or contain), cover fills, contain keeps the whole picture.

x.description: cover: the window's centre across, -1 to 1.

y.description: cover: the window's centre down, -1 to 1.

shape.description: The video's shape; null puts its own back.

style_id.description: Switch the whole video to this style (a style_id they named, or one of theirs in get_profile own_styles): the same cut in the new look, saved as a new version that is drawn again, a minute or more, and uses one change in words. Saved alone. check_video says when it is ready.

video_id.description: Video; the open one if left out.

name: set_look

outputSchema.description: Clypmint set_look result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Change the picture
